name: RAPP Crispy
summary: A local-first meeting stack. Records a meeting, removes background noise with RNNoise, transcribes it on a whisper.cpp server bound to 127.0.0.1, and writes Summary / Decisions / Action items / Open questions through a hook you own. Capture, denoising and transcription never leave the machine; the default notes hook calls `claude -p`, which sends the transcript to Anthropic. Denoise quality is measured, not asserted.
tagline: Record, denoise, transcribe and summarise meetings entirely on your own machine.
egg_note: Ships with no state. The egg is the hatch cartridge (twin persona + agent only) and contains no recordings, transcripts, vocabulary or personal data. Meetings you create stay on your own disk under ~/.rappcrispy/meetings.

optional: a loopback CoreAudio device for the live virtual microphone
